selection: All5 architectures and2 seeds. Nested groups ranked by discovery-axis overlap, nominal atom-slot budgets8/32/64. A fixed random group ordering per fit and task gives nested controls. Shared unions have fewer unique atoms; actual rank/atomcounts recorded, not claimed exactly dimension matched. Rank1 supervised axis controls included.
interventions: Projection onto union span; encoded active selected-group union decoded once per atom, scaled by native rawRMS per input. Random projection also rescaled to own ranked-projection edit norm, explicitly pairwise oracle control. No norm calibration of learned encodings. Supervised rank1 axis uses projection only.
evaluation: All78 aligned H849 pairs both directions, agreement/sentiment formats and gaps. Full raw donor and identity controls. Task selection is discovery-supervised and tasks broadly reused; not unsupervised semantic recovery. Random groups rank matched but not norm matched; record edit norms.
question: Does a geometrically/behaviorally stable component carry task-selective causal effects, or is signal distributed/encoder-limited?
